maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from ad spend run through its self-service programmatic advertising platform, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are brands and agencies such as Disney+, Spotify and General Mills, paying with private advertising budgets.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by organic platform adoption and ad spend growth, with only occasional small acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Advertisers can move budgets between demand-side platforms fairly easily, though UID2 and data integrations add some friction.

notes: Mission-critical is borderline because identity and data integrations create some switching friction.
